title: [v0.92.1][tooling] Reconcile native pull-request ready mutations
goal: Make native pull-request ready mutations deterministic, authenticated, and recoverable exactly once after confirmed absence.
summary: Replace the invalid ready mutation route, bind success to exact PR and head readback, and persist one-shot recovery consumption.
required_outcome: Native pull_request_ready distinguishes rejected, still-draft, and ready outcomes and cannot ambiguously replay.
target_files_surfaces: csdlc-v3 GitHub operational adapter, remote mutation state machine, focused tests, and issue #824 proof packet.
repo_inputs: Issue #824; parent #522; redacted #814 regression packet; native v3 remote mutation contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Offline regression reproduces; exact ready mutation and readback succeed; authenticated absence permits one recovery; stale head, wrong PR, still-draft, already-ready, and repeated recovery cases are proven.
non_goals: No paid cloud mutation, broad GitHub API redesign, raw gh lifecycle write, or #520 worktree change.
validation_plan: Focused remote/adapter tests, regression validator and negative fixtures, formatter, clippy, native card validation, and diff hygiene.
dependencies: Parent #522 and #814 readiness; no external mutation dependency.
deliverables: Ready mutation repair, one-shot recovery receipt, focused tests, retained redacted regression packet, and validator.
docs_context: Native C-SDLC v3 GitHub remote mutation tooling.
notes_risks: Durable intent must prevent ambiguous replay across timeout and restart.
